notes: Brokers (ST_BROKER): number max + 1 (generated key, legacy NVL(MAX)+1), no duplicate, detail account and active cost centres (legacy LOVs), delete refused while sales documents use the broker (APP_RULES3_SA, trigger APP_R3_ST_BROKER_BD)

row_rules.ST_BROKER:
-- legacy PRE-INSERT / LOVs: no duplicate, account ACCOUNT_STATUS = 1, active cost centres (delete check: trigger APP_R3_ST_BROKER_BD)
app_rules3_sa.broker_row(inserting, :new.broker_code, :new.account_number, :new.cost_code, :new.cost_code2);

ST_BROKER.ACCOUNT_NUMBER.lov: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or account_number in (select p.account_number from ac_password_master p where p.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE)) order by account_number

ST_BROKER.COST_CODE.lov: select c.cost_code || ' - ' || c.cost_desc d, c.cost_code r from ac_cost_centers c where nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or c.cost_code in (select m2.cost_code from ac_cost_centers m2, ac_password_cost1 p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE and rpad(substr(to_char(p2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, 0) = rpad(substr(to_char(m2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, 0) and m2.cost_status = 1) order by 2

ST_BROKER.COST_CODE2.lov: select c.cost_code || ' - ' || c.cost_desc d, c.cost_code r from ac_cost_centers2 c where nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or :G_COMPANY_CODE is null or c.cost_code in (select m2.cost_code from ac_cost_centers2 m2, ac_password_cost2 p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = :G_COMPANY_CODE and rpad(substr(to_char(p2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, 0) = rpad(substr(to_char(m2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, 0) and m2.cost_status = 1) order by 2
